response.text:
If you’re buying women’s kurta sets online in India, I’d shortlist **Libas, Biba, W for Woman, Aurelia, and Fabindia**\. Each is good for a slightly different style and budget, so you don’t need to spend a lot to find something lovely.

![Online Fashion & Lifestyle Shopping for Women, Men & Kids in India - Tata CLiQ](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eKSYDjW60PE529dfKl-NG2WGsnTJ1pctzb8uDEc8aPWe6MflvbsTea8nDSPkqGyJTyOBVIT6yAmXfe--YBZzzTlMUnstJzG4jAokOoLvOGMf5X9cHmfDgtA1ZTDhFQnlfX8917V2h2ATYoAMRczxuxo6gmCFUcuHoBErIvwKJT_0Sv9HyN_NjiYO5Cq9X9bV?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Libas

(Best overall value)

**Best for\:** Trendy everyday wear, family outings and versatile styles.

A good first stop if you want lots of colours, prints, straight-fit suits and festive designs at different price points. Its online collection includes plenty of options around ₹800–₹2,000 on discount. A dependable choice for traditional prints, colourful designs and wearable silhouettes. Look for cotton sets if breathability and regular use are priorities.

![Buy W Embroidered Straight Kurta Set from W at just INR 4599.0](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/XL2oMSbQLivOhQCCRcIShec7wtOzDzHkfJX0sVQxoEe-UnkJFCzqII5epI_d8D6Jq9n1b6woz63DpaOGJ075C_ksQxutbZuHl9A7DYSqfuJGrfKXFY72WdEsjffQHqkOC4RZtGbhsNVM1d6ukEpDxVFxD3VKZbM9FWNuty_w2ocorIEIRZuthUGvnOEXsVAf?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. W for Woman

**Best for\:** Office wear and smart, polished outfits.

Choose this brand for contemporary cuts, coordinated trousers and understated embroidery that work well for the office and dinners.

Shop: [W for Woman official website](https://www.wforwoman.com/)

---

        Online for Woman | Shop for Aurelia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/sUB9ZYePZ80FEdoN3uvFshE58pvE69cDv3aXrw62xi3RaDIBKdvtFe7m05_UbzbLDjWeAnlClt9BnkljuASYPXnr_0wgfTJp3Ria2pylkPjAUNDX1sY4WtGyaC0geTcyGwcxytucVJuArUsEdFN1H55Wog730y7YmXy1VArTzSvMKO3i3s42aNhCVw8gt4wL?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Aurelia

**Best for\:** Affordable daily wear and semi-formal occasions.

Worth browsing for easy-to-wear Indian outfits, coordinated sets and dressier designs without going fully into wedding wear.

Shop: [Aurelia official website](https://www.aurelia.in/)

---

![Buy  Mustard Cotton Hand Block Print Pant, Dupatta & Kurta Set for Women Online at Fabindia | 20281395](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-S8O-23WctzJgSC8SNMJ188due73x3340I5TlaR7MvcjWo1wx0vSbh0BHkj6Bstl85NqOHDdGAjGUJg0QpBcEKrFzWakHY8FdyqkpKjU42o6z1e7hUSjad3KScYqhixop5P9BvsMHv9knRE6h8-JNB8SqC5M6tez4Bu1SA2tAYk4ZHEyenYL4H4i9-B0ZkjA?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Fabindia

**Best for\:** Classic prints, natural-looking fabrics and understated elegance.

A strong option if you prefer timeless Indian styles, cotton-rich fabrics and a more artisanal aesthetic. Expect some styles to cost more than mass-market alternatives.

|--------|--------|

**My recommendation\:** Start with Libas for variety and value, or W for Woman if you want elegant, office-friendly sets.
